bull_case: AI custom accelerators, networking and VMware cash flows scale together. Bull owner FCF/share rises from $9.5 to $57 over ten years; locked 25x terminal gives about $797.84/share. This requires multiple large AI customers, durable custom-silicon share and strong software cash conversion.
bear_case: AI accelerator demand normalizes after the current buildout, large customers internalize more silicon, and customer/TSMC concentration reduces bargaining power. Bear path grows owner FCF/share only from $7.5 to $12.5 over ten years; locked 15x terminal multiple gives about $137.04/share.
thesis: At the frozen $357.61 close, the locked-policy DCF produces Bear/Base/Bull values of about $137/$404/$798. Price/Base is 0.884, so current price does not require the Bull case, but Base still assumes exceptional AI-led expansion and 68% of Base operating value is terminal value. The valuation gap is therefore positive but not robust enough to treat consensus-scale AI growth as certain.

evidence.claim: Q3 FY2026 revenue was $29.591B (+86% y/y), operating income $15.955B and net income $13.088B.
9M FY2026 OCF was $32.950B, capex $1.013B and SBC $6.287B. TTM owner-FCF proxy calculated as FY2025 + 9M FY2026 - 9M FY2025 for OCF, capex and SBC is about $30.921B or $6.33/share.
evidence.source: User-supplied FY2025 Annual Report and 2025/2026 Q3 10-Qs; downstream arithmetic

evidence.claim: Top five end customers represented approximately 55% of Q3 FY2026 revenue and approximately 50% of 9M revenue; approximately 95% of contract-manufactured wafers were produced by TSMC.
Remaining performance obligations were approximately $179.2B at 2026-08-02 and include a long-term custom AI accelerator contract.
Official Q4 FY2026 revenue guidance is approximately $34.8B, +93% y/y. If achieved, FY2026 revenue would be roughly $105.9B.
Locked-policy DCF at 9% required return and 15x/20x/25x terminal multiples yields Bear $137.04, Base $404.48 and Bull $797.84 with frozen net cash/share -$7.2527.

counterevidence: The Base case is deliberately below the current external consensus revenue trajectory, but it still requires roughly 44% FY2025-to-FY2028 revenue CAGR and a large increase in per-share cash generation.
Base terminal value is about 68% of Base operating value; Bull terminal value is about 75%, so long-duration assumptions remain a major valuation driver.
Customer concentration has risen materially: the top five end customers account for roughly half of revenue, while the largest custom-AI customers are also capable of internal silicon development.
The latest filing indicates AI/custom XPU and AI rack mix can improve operating margin while compressing gross margin, so current operating leverage should not be extrapolated mechanically.
unknowns: Individual revenue shares, contract economics and cancellation/volume-flex terms for the largest custom AI accelerator customers.
How much of the $179.2B RPO is custom AI silicon versus software, and its recognition/margin profile beyond the next 12 months.
Sustainable owner-FCF margin after the current AI capacity buildout and VMware integration matures.
Long-run share of hyperscaler accelerator spend won by Broadcom versus internally designed or competing custom silicon.
No frozen 5-year valuation percentile is available; EV relies on the locked DCF rather than a historical percentile signal.
falsifiers: If FY2027 revenue is below $125B or owner FCF/share is below $11, the Base path should be cut materially.
If the top-five customer share rises above 60% while gross margin and contract visibility weaken, concentration risk should move from a monitoring item to a core valuation haircut.
If owner FCF/share reaches at least $17 by FY2028 while RPO remains above $150B and customer concentration does not worsen, the Bear case becomes materially less plausible.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $357.61 is below locked-policy Bull value $797.84 and equals only 0.884x Base $404.48. The defined veto requires current price to exceed Bull value, which is not satisfied.

Reconcile VMware software cash conversion and acquisition-amortization treatment in RF before using EV as a portfolio-sizing input.
Update the Base revenue path when FY2027 company guidance is available; do not substitute external consensus for company evidence.

Owner FCF treatment subtracts SBC and uses Q3 diluted shares; working-capital timing and integration economics can move the cash path materially.
